messages:
Emma CSM: FYI — automated spend flag for Nebula Labs popped this morning. Their hosted commit is $8k/mo; current 7d burn = $9.2k (projected month ~ $27k). Flagged as high variance.

Rahul CSM: Yikes, 3.4x projected. What changed? Any latency / error signals?

billing-bot: alert: account=nebula-labs, metric=hosted_spend, baseline=8000, 7d_usage=9200, proj_30d=27600, reason=bursting_tokens. link: https://billing.redwood/flags/2312345678

Ava SE: Nebula rolled out a reranker last week. Context length jumped from ~512 to ~2048 tokens per request — that'll blow token counts up.

Liam SRE: Quick check on infra: p95 latency +12ms in eu-west1 over 48h, 5xx stable. 4xx spike around 2026-03-18 03:14 UTC tied to a config deploy (auth header mismatch). Not a server-side failure.

Emma CSM: Does batching/autotune explain spend jump or was it pure token inflation? Any cache misses?

Ava SE: Caching is disabled client-side — they use user-specific prefixes so prefix-KV caching is currently off. Also: their `/v1/rerank` endpoint accounts for ~60% of tokens.

Rahul CSM: Action plan: 1) Send Nebula quick mitigations (shorten context, reduce candidate set), 2) Offer 30-min optimization call, 3) Flag renewal risk as elevated if no changes in 2 weeks.

Emma CSM: I'll draft the email. @Ava SE can you prepare a short playbook + before/after prompt samples by EOD? @Liam SRE can you query tokens-per-call by endpoint for the last 7d?

Liam SRE: On it. Example query I ran: `select endpoint, avg(tokens) as avg_tokens, count(*) from request_logs where account='nebula-labs' and ts > now()-interval '7 days' group by endpoint order by avg_tokens desc;` Results show `/v1/rerank` avg_tokens=1842, `/v1/generate` avg_tokens=640.

billing-bot: note: anomaly ticket created (#B-9043). Billing alerted product & cs.

Ava SE: Recommendations ready: - Shorten context to 512 where possible - Reduce reranker candidate size from 50 -> 12 - Enable prefix-KV cache for stable prefixes - Add sampling on high-cost routes to cap token burn - Offer a dedicated quantized model for cheaper dedicated tier (if they want persistent low-cost ops)

Emma CSM: I'll include those in the email. Scheduling call for Nebula tomorrow 10:00 PT.

Rahul CSM: If they decline the call, propose a temporary spend cap / burst cap to prevent surprise overages.

Liam SRE: I can push a temporary token-per-minute cap (50k/min) on the account if CS approves.

Emma CSM: Approve the temporary cap. Liam, proceed and confirm when set. I'll cc the customer in the invite and include spend protection options.

Ava SE: Playbook link: https://drive.redwood/private/nebula-playbook (sharing). Contains diffs, sample prompts, and migration checklist.

Emma CSM: Thanks everyone — will update after the call and mark follow-up tasks in the account board. :spiral_calendar:
